card.name: Mixed positions before next word
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered tokens such as 'Mount', 'only', 'ently' in 'Permanently', a space before a number, or 'month'.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space token just before a number in a list of days or weights.
